messages.subject: Generated quantities with tmbstan (from the TMB object)
parts:
Hi!

I have a "tmbstan" model and I would like to obtain generated quantities but for a random variable and not for the parameters (https://github.com/kaskr/tmbstan/blob/master/README.md)

I simulated a random variable with normal distribution using the TMB function "SIMULATE()" but I don't know if I could do something similar like the Stan expression: "generated quantities{}" in the template of TMB. 

I will be grateful if someone can help me. 
Best wishes,

messages.author: 4453e5ef4c1cb06e
messages.subject: Re: Generated quantities with tmbstan (from the TMB object)
parts:
I think what you want to do is simulate a random variable given the uncertainty in the parameter estimates, correct? So like posterior predictive data? In that case you can modify the example code you linked and do

`r <- obj$simulate(post[i,-ncol(post)])`

Then extract whatever you need from `r`. The posterior contains uncertainty in the parameters, and the simulator will add observation error. That's the equivalent of Stan's approach. 

-Cole
